schema.name: CiscoMerakiFileScannedEvents_CL
schema.description: The CiscoMerakiFileScannedEvents table contains Cisco Meraki appliance file scanning detections, including the file URI, disposition, action, size, and hash information for evaluated files.

columns.name: EventType
columns.description: Cisco Meraki event type for the file scan result.

columns.name: DeviceMac
columns.description: MAC address of the Meraki appliance associated with the event.

columns.name: ClientMac
columns.description: Client MAC address associated with the file scan.

columns.name: SourceIp
columns.description: Source IP address for the file transfer or request.

columns.name: DestinationIp
columns.description: Destination IP address for the file transfer or request.

columns.name: Uri
columns.description: URI or URL evaluated by the file scan engine.

columns.name: Disposition
columns.description: Threat disposition returned by the file scanning engine.

columns.name: Action
columns.description: Action taken against the scanned file.

columns.name: FileHash
columns.description: Hash value of the downloaded or scanned file.

columns.name: EventMessage
columns.description: Raw event message for the file scan result.

columns.name: EventProduct
columns.description: Product name reported in the event.

columns.name: EventVendor
columns.description: Vendor name reported in the event.

columns.name: EventCount
columns.description: Event count value for the source record.
